title: Span dict-style .get (tracing span entity): raise a guiding AttributeError from the __getattr__ hook, never a real get method
answers: Why does span.get('name') on a trace span raise AttributeError saying 'a span is not a dict'?
Why does hasattr(span, 'get') return False on a MLflow trace span even though span.get is rejected?
How do I make LazySpan or NoOpSpan give the same helpful error for an unsupported dict method?
Where is the hint for calling .get on a span (use span.name, span.inputs, span.get_attribute) generated?
body:
Path: mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.__getattr__ handles failed attribute lookups on tracing spans (LiveSpan, immutable Span, LazySpan, NoOpSpan) when user or agent code uses dict-style `span.get(...)` instead of `span.name`, `span.inputs`, `span.outputs`, `span.attributes`, or `span.get_attribute(key)`.
Rule: Steer dict-style access on Span through the `__getattr__` hook that raises AttributeError for name == "get" with the attribute-access hint; do not define a real `get` method, because that makes hasattr(span, "get") True and breaks duck-typing probes. Sibling to the TypeError hint in Span.__getitem__.
Rule: LazySpan.__getattr__ must materialize first, try object.__getattribute__, and on AttributeError fall through to super().__getattr__(name), so the hint reaches lazily loaded spans too.
Symptom: span.get("name") raised a bare "'Span' object has no attribute 'get'" with no pointer to span.name or get_attribute, and coding agents kept reaching for .get about as often as subscript access.
Constraints: Applies to span attribute lookups in mlflow/entities/span.py. Tested in tests/entities/test_span.py:test_span_get_raises_helpful_attribute_error across LiveSpan, immutable Span, LazySpan and NoOpSpan. The hook only covers name == "get"; other names get a plain AttributeError. Do not use this for real Span fields, which resolve normally.
applies: Span entity attribute access on tracing spans in mlflow/entities/span.py, including LazySpan and NoOpSpan.
says: Accessing trace span properties using dictionary lookup methods provides no helpful field guidance.
Suggest the proper attribute names when users query trace span details like a dictionary.
Calling unsupported dictionary methods on lazy trace spans crashes without directing users to attributes.
Guide developers toward correct span fields when attempting key-based value extraction on traces.
search: To guide callers attempting dict-style access on tracing spans without breaking duck-typing checks via hasattr, mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.__getattr__ intercepts get and raises an AttributeError directing users to specific fields or get_attribute. In LazySpan.__getattr__, the instance materializes first and attempts object.__getattribute__ before delegating to super().__getattr__ so the guidance applies consistently to lazily loaded spans. The mechanism applies strictly to name == "get" across LiveSpan, immutable Span, LazySpan, and NoOpSpan, while regular attributes resolve normally and other missing names raise standard AttributeErrors.
